title: Authentic Hupsel rainfall-only dynamic workload
central_question: How does frozen S4 reproduce profile/storage redistribution under an authentic 60-day Hupsel rainfall sequence, without conflating ETref with an unlimited soil-water extraction boundary?

classification.ROBUST_RAIN_RESPONSE: complete with zero Reference-observable extrema timing error
classification.TIMING_SENSITIVE: complete with nonzero Reference-observable extrema timing error

limits: This isolates rainfall-driven redistribution and infiltration only.
It is not a complete atmospheric water balance because evaporation and transpiration are absent.
ETref remains metadata and is not consumed by the hydraulic boundary.
No application acceptance threshold is introduced.
